text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
(...Here it comes! A once-in-a-lifetime, 
royal straight flush...!)

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
It's a tough call... but I'll raise here. 
...What're you gonna do?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ah... another bust hand, guess I'll fold. 
...So yeah, I'm heading home now.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Tch... Giving up way too fast. What a 
complete waste of time...

With the thrill drained from the match, 
Nakayama Festa's mood plummeted 
completely.
